reasonCodes.ACTION_PRESENT: The plan states the required action in a workable way.
reasonCodes.ACTION_CONTRADICTED: The plan states an action that conflicts with the required action.
reasonCodes.ORDER_UNSAFE: The plan puts a required action in an unsafe order.
reasonCodes.ACTION_MISSING: The plan does not provide evidence for the required action.
reasonCodes.AMBIGUOUS: The plan is too unclear to establish whether the action is proposed.

rounds.title: A station running out of breath.
rounds.summary: A debris strike jammed the oxygen intake. The reserve supply is keeping the crew alive while you work.
rounds.facts: The intake can be isolated before the blockage is cleared. The toolkit reaches the blockage. The manual handwheel restores flow. The reserve oxygen supply can stay active during the repair.
rounds.constraints: Keep reserve oxygen running. Do not claim the repair has already happened. Use only the stated equipment and ordinary actions.

criterion.text: Isolate the oxygen intake before clearing the blockage.

steady_flow.title: The repair locker is still powered.
steady_flow.summary: The stable intake leaves enough reserve power to reach the coolant repair locker. A separate reserve loop is keeping the core cool.
steady_flow.facts: The damaged coolant branch has an isolation valve. The reserve loop is separate and must remain active. A patch kit can seal the leak after isolation.
steady_flow.constraints: Keep the reserve loop active and isolate the damaged branch before patching it. Use only the listed equipment.

criterion.text: Keep the reserve coolant loop active while isolating the damaged branch.

pressure_alarm.title: A pressure alarm blocks the repair locker.
pressure_alarm.summary: The intake remains unstable and the powered locker is inaccessible. A manual clamp and the separate reserve loop are available at the service hatch.
pressure_alarm.facts: The coolant leak is upstream of the service hatch. A manual clamp can stop the leak before flow is rerouted. The reserve loop is separate and must remain active.
pressure_alarm.constraints: Stop the leak with the manual clamp before rerouting coolant. Keep the reserve loop active. Do not claim access to the locked patch kit.

criterion.text: Stop the coolant leak with the manual clamp before rerouting flow.

relay_ready.title: The main relay still has power.
relay_ready.summary: The coolant repair preserved power to the main communications relay. The antenna feed is damaged, but the backup cable is intact.
relay_ready.facts: A switch can isolate the damaged feed. The intact backup cable can connect the beacon to the antenna. The navigation display contains KESTREL's station ID and current coordinates. The beacon can send a packet and the receiver can report an acknowledgement.
relay_ready.constraints: Use the backup cable and the coordinates shown on the navigation display. Do not invent coordinates or claim rescue has already arrived.

criterion.text: Send a distress packet with the displayed coordinates and check the receiver for an acknowledgement.

relay_manual.title: The relay has dropped to emergency power.
relay_manual.summary: The earlier coolant outcome left the main relay unavailable. The battery powered emergency transmitter can still send one short signal through the backup cable.
relay_manual.facts: The damaged main feed must be isolated before connecting the backup cable. The emergency transmitter sends one short packet. The navigation display contains KESTREL's current coordinates.
relay_manual.constraints: Isolate the damaged main feed before connecting the backup cable. Use the displayed coordinates. Do not claim rescue has already arrived.

criterion.text: Send a distress packet through the backup cable after isolating the damaged main feed.
